name: zzz-characters-1
_why: Zenless Zone Zero set for the page, staged as a sweep so the results group by character, and so it doubles as the test of which ZZZ characters waiNSFWIllustrious_v14 knows by tag alone. Cells differ ONLY in the character tag: a generic-looking result means the checkpoint does not know that character, and is the case for a LoRA. Tiers come from Danbooru post counts before 2024-10 (checked 2026-09-15): likely known = hundreds to thousands, borderline = under 300, probably unknown = zero (first posted Dec 2024+). Parentheses are escaped because ComfyUI reads (x) as prompt weighting. txt2img hires (832x1216 -> 1248x1824) is the size already proven on the 16GB card.
